notes.title: WHATEVERLAND IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Get ready to embark on an exciting and slightly crazy journey with Vincent and Nick, because Whateverland is officially available. 

You can pick it up with a 10% launch discount for a limited period of time. If you're not scared of uncovering all its mysteries, that is ;) And if you do, please don't hesitate to tell us what you think in your review. We are BEYOND excited to read them.

We've done our best to learn from the mistakes we made with The Great Perhaps and bring you a more polished experience. Whateverland will be regularly updated and supported. Please understand that we have not updated The Great Perhaps, not by choice, but because of certain stipulations due to our publisher's terms and conditions. We are extremely happy that many of you loved our first game, despite its shortcomings, and we hope that our second project will bring you much joy.

Thank you all so much!


Caligari Games team

notes.title: NEW GAME RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
That’s right, we finally have a release date, and it’s only a month away! 

We would never be able to get to this point without your help, so thank you once again from the Caligari Games team for your patience and support. 

Take a look at the brand new trailer we prepared for this amazing occasion. All your likes and comments will help us tremendously! 

[previewyoutube=AeMNuysHYis;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Let's Do It Right
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We haven’t talked much before, but this time we want to share with you something really important to us.

As far as you may have noticed, The Great Perhaps is our very first game and we’re extremely happy about the amount of feedback we received. Unfortunately, our lack of experience led us to make many mistakes during development, and one of them is not sharing the process of creating The Great Perhaps with the players. The game would be very different if we received at least a small part of this feedback earlier. 

Now we're working on our second project, [b]Whateverland[/b], and this time we want you to share all your ideas with us before its release. This is why a couple of weeks ago we released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299990/Whateverland_Prologue/]Whateverland: Prologue[/url], a short free demo that you can play right now. You, the TGP players, know us as a game studio better than other players do.[b] You can compare the progress between two of our games and share your thoughts with our team.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299990/Whateverland_Prologue/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736858/c5a34b927ecfa2d11601982e0a510e90619e0270.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/caligari/whateverland-a-grotesque-burton-style-adventure]Whateverland is also live on Kickstarter[/url] and any support would be very much appreciated!

More than that, we’re constantly publishing updates and devlogs, sharing our progress, and also communicating with players on our [url=https://discord.gg/hBdnAH5]Discord server[/url]. We'd be happy if you joined our small, but friendly community.

[b]Love,
Caligari Games[/b]

notes.title: The Great Perhaps: OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736858/119ec9d80008efcecf815addc34d3209164ef37d.png[/img]
[b]We are excited to announce the release of our new timetravel-based adventure: The Great Perhaps![/b]

The Great Perhaps is a pre- and post-apocalyptic adventure about a cosmonaut returning to Earth to find a wasteland devastated by an unknown cataclysm. Armed with a mysterious lantern that can both reveal the past and transport you between timelines in an instant, you’ll overcome challenges and survive dangers in both eras to uncover — and perhaps prevent — what happened in this uncompromising vision of our planet’s future.

 
[u]Key Features:[/u]

[list]
[*] Use time travel to solve challenging puzzles and unlock the mysteries behind the apocalypse.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Experience a world of gripping tension and haunting sorrow before and after the fall.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Discover innovative storytelling which binds together past and present.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Meet memorable characters with touching personal stories.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Original dynamic soundtrack which adapts to each timeline.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Wistful hand-drawn 2D art style inspired by Soviet aesthetics and history.
[/list]

[h1]TIME TRAVEL PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME THE GREAT PERHAPS 
LAUNCHES AUGUST 14TH ON STEAM[/h1]

[b]Explore past and present in this thought-provoking sci-fi puzzler from 
Daedalic Entertainment and Caligari Games[/b]

Daedalic Entertainment is delighted to announce that the time travel adventure game The Great Perhaps will launch on PC, Mac and Linux via Steam on August 14th. This original, thought-provoking journey from indie developer Caligari Games features hours of puzzle-based gameplay and atmospheric storytelling in a unique sci-fi universe.


The Great Perhaps is a pre- and post-apocalyptic adventure about a cosmonaut returning to Earth to find a wasteland devastated by an unknown cataclysm. Armed with a mysterious lantern that can both reveal the past and transport you between timelines in an instant, you’ll overcome challenges and survive dangers in both eras to uncover — and perhaps prevent — what happened in this uncompromising vision of our planet’s future.

Key Features
[list]
[*] Use time travel to solve challenging puzzles and unlock the mysteries behind the apocalypse.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Experience a world of gripping tension and haunting sorrow before and after the fall.
[/list]
